author: Muktha Ramesh
name: Hierarchical Chunked Transformer (H-net Inspired)
blurb: MegaByte-style hierarchical transformer: 7-layer global model (448-dim) over T/G=128 chunk tokens + 3-layer local model (256-dim) over G=16 token windows in parallel. First hierarchical chunked architecture in this competition. Standard eval (not sliding window). ~15.2M params, int8+zlib.
notes: Non-record submission. Standard eval (no sliding window). First H-net inspired submission in Parameter Golf. val_bpb is after int8+zlib quantization roundtrip.
